Welcome. I’m so glad you’re here, ready to join me on this journey—a journey that’s as courageous as it is deeply human.
Together, we’ll step into the world of Know My Name, the remarkable memoir by Chanel Miller. In these pages, identity, trauma, and resilience become tightly woven threads, telling a story that’s both intensely personal and powerfully universal.
Imagine what it’s like when your life is suddenly shattered by violence, and you’re forced to piece it back together in front of a world that doesn’t always want to listen.
But as we explore Chanel’s story, we see it’s more than just pain—it’s about the raw honesty of facing your memories, the heavy weight of shame, and the fight to reclaim your voice when everything tries to silence you.
What makes this journey so compelling is the way vulnerability stands right alongside strength. There’s a tension, a pulse, as we watch the pursuit of justice shape not only the outcome of a trial, but the very heart of self-discovery.
As we move forward together, you’ll notice how Chanel’s experiences, though so personal, shine a light on what so many survivors face: the hidden costs of trauma, the courage it takes to challenge judgment and doubt, and the exhausting path through legal systems and public scrutiny.
But through it all—through the pain and the perseverance—there’s a powerful emergence of a new self. One that refuses to be defined only by what’s been lost or endured, but instead, boldly claims the right to be seen, to be heard, and to be truly known.
So, let’s explore this story together. Let’s open our minds and hearts, and see what it means to find hope, agency, and transformation—no matter how winding the path may be.
